name: Lucario Morph
description: Play as Lucario, Mega Lucario or Riolu: the /lucario and /riolu commands replace the player model (models and animations from Lucario Overhaul by JoeSeff). Client-side only: works on any server, even vanilla — morphs and emote animations sync through an external service (you can add your own mirror in the config), and your morph record is automatically protected against spoofing via Mojang authentication.
